name: topia
description: 71-skill Topia Nexus for Claude Code — discipline rails via native hooks (readiness/guardian/completion-gate/quarantine). 315 synapses + 49 pulses, Maestro routing, optional agora-code neural memory. Use topia:build for code, topia:architecture-mapper for legacy mapping, topia:team for parallel work, topia:launch for deploy, topia:rescue for legacy code.

gitBand.title: Git band
gitBand.description: Show changed / unpushed counts above the prompt with Commit and Push buttons. The default: /mods git overrides it for you or one project

standingOrders.title: Standing orders
standingOrders.description: Per-project rules added to the system prompt, toggled with /orders (all off until you turn one on). The default: /mods orders overrides it for you or one project

remoteHosts.title: Remote hosts
remoteHosts.description: Remember SSH hosts from ssh calls that worked in this project and list them to the model (kept per project, never in the repo); /hosts. The default: /mods hosts overrides it for you or one project

quietReports.title: Quiet Topia reports
quietReports.description: Keep Topia session reports and banners out of the model context; usage in the status line; /topia-activity. The default: /mods quiet overrides it for you or one project

modelPreset.title: Model preset
modelPreset.description: Remember the model used per project and switch to it at startup; /model-preset. The default: /mods model overrides it for you or one project

promptRouting.title: Prompt routing
promptRouting.description: Show above the prompt, as you type, which Topia skills your wording points at, with the trigger words underlined; after the turn, predicted vs ran. The default: /mods routing overrides it for you or one project

promptRoutingHint.title: Prompt routing hint for the model
promptRoutingHint.description: Also hand that reading to the model beside your prompt (never shown in the transcript), so skill-router sees what you meant
